objections.text: The hand-derived duplicate-key case sends the same first and second rego values and already requires OPENJSON-compatible first-occurrence behavior. A02 repeats that input and mechanism.
The hand-derived temperature-rounding case already sends temp 3.965 in the same document shape and requires 3.97. A03 is the same attack with only the registration changed.
The hand-derived NULL-document case already calls the procedure with a NULL argument and requires no error and no inserted rows. A06 is identical.
